SELECT 
    e.equipmentcode,
    ce.heaterstatus,
    t.insulationstatus,
    ls.emergencylightstatus,
    ROUND(CAST(
        (100 - ws.structuralloadpercent) / 100.0 * 
        CASE 
            WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
            WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50 OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
            ELSE 1.0
        END
    AS numeric), 4) AS structure_margin,
    CASE 
        WHEN (
            (100 - ws.structuralloadpercent) / 100.0 * 
            CASE 
                WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
                WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50 OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
                ELSE 1.0
            END
        ) > 0.7 
        AND ce.heaterstatus != 'Off'
        AND t.insulationstatus != 'Poor'
        AND ls.emergencylightstatus IN ('On', 'Testing')
        THEN 'Extreme Weather Ready'
        ELSE 'Not Ready'
    END AS readiness_label

JOIN cabinenvironment ce ON ce.cabineqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON t.thermaleqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN lightingandsafety ls ON ls.lighteqref = e.equipmentcode
JOIN weatherandstructure ws ON ws.weatherlocref = (SELECT l.locationregistry FROM location l WHERE l.loceqref = e.equipmentcode LIMIT 1)

    (

        CASE 
            WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 100 OR ws.windspeedms > 20 THEN 0.5
            WHEN ws.snowloadkgm2 > 50 OR ws.windspeedms > 10 THEN 0.8
            ELSE 1.0
        END
    ) > 0.7
    AND ce.heaterstatus != 'Off'
    AND t.insulationstatus != 'Poor'
    AND ls.emergencylightstatus IN ('On', 'Testing');
